description: Find the nearest 24-hour emergency animal hospital that is open right now. Use when a pet needs urgent or emergency care, the user asks for an emergency vet, an animal ER, or a vet open late at night, on weekends, or on holidays. Results are sorted by distance with open-now enforced. For life-threatening emergencies, tell the user to go to the nearest ER immediately instead of calling around. Read-only: it only searches public listings.

limit.description: How many results to return, 1-10. Default 5.

location.description: Where to search: a city, address, ZIP code, or 'latitude,longitude'.

pet.description: Optional pet info. Species changes which clinics are searched (e.g. horse searches equine vets). Breed and name are display-only and are never stored.

breed.description: Breed, e.g. 'King Charles Cavalier'. Optional, display only.

name.description: Pet's name. Optional, display only, never stored.

species.description: One of: dog, cat, horse, bird, reptile, small_mammal, other.

name: find_emergency_vet
